piano-warm.prompt: An old upright piano heard through a wall from the next room of a quiet house. Someone plays a simple warm melody for themselves, unhurried, a little out of tune, with small hesitations and a held note at the end. Solo piano only, instrumental, no drums, no strings, no reverb wash, intimate and domestic, recorded from the next room.
piano-warm.for: Warmth late in a visit, through the wall where the laughter lives (the next-room situation).

piano-unresolved.prompt: An upright piano in another room. A sparse, uncertain phrase in a major key that keeps not resolving, long pauses between notes, quiet, slightly dissonant on the last chord, then it simply stops mid-phrase. Solo piano only, instrumental, no drums, no strings, muffled as if heard through a closed door.
piano-unresolved.for: Contradiction: a phrase that starts warmly and does not resolve, then stops.

memory-radio.prompt: An ordinary cheerful song playing on the radio in a sunny kitchen: a light, easy-going 1970s soft-pop instrumental with strummed acoustic guitar, a round bass line, brushed drums and a little electric piano, major key, relaxed mid tempo, warm and happy, nothing dramatic. It starts straight away in the middle of the song, no intro, no build and no ending, it simply carries on. Instrumental, no vocals.
memory-radio.for: Memory: "We ate cereal for dinner and it was perfect." The kitchen radio, on from the moment the scene has formed.
